inputs.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a wide shot frames a busy city intersection at dusk as a military-green Decepticon, a semi-truck that has just transformed into a towering mech, tears up the asphalt and Spider-Man swings down between two skyscrapers onto the crosswalk. The camera tracks right with medium amplitude as the mech backhands a bus-stop pole, snapping it into a storefront window; Spider-Man springs off a fire hydrant and webs the mech knee, swinging past a tram that blares its horn. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at fast speed as the mech stomps, cracking the pavement and toppling a rack of parked scooters. Spider-Man vaults over an overturned taxi and shoots a web at a rooftop crane hook, hauling a steel girder down into the mech shoulder. The camera shakes strongly as the girder shears a billboard and staggers the mech into a streetlamp and a newsstand, collapsing both. Spider-Man lands on a rooftop water tower and the mech swings its arm through it, sending water and torn signage across the street. The camera pulls out with small amplitude at slow speed as the two face off over scattered debris, shattered glass, and dislodged traffic signals.

overall_soundscape: A trucking mech grinds and hisses under the roar of its engine as glass and metal shatter, the tram bell clangs, and a taxi horn blares. Pavement cracks, scooters clatter, and water and loose signage spill across the road, ending with the slow creak of the water tower and Spider-Man short panting breaths.

non_diegetic_music: Massive orchestral percussion at a fast tempo with low brass and rising strings, accenting each heavy strike and resolving on a single sustained low tone as the two face off.
